purpose: Five two-minute stories, each with a number, built from real work.
why: Applied-AI interviews ask: did you understand the workflow, did you ship, did you measure it. Your stories answer all three.

video.title: Communication for engineers
video.summary: How to put yourself in the other person's shoes before you answer: what they know, what they're worried about, what they need from you. Context engineering as a communication habit, for people and for models. Frameworks for interview calls: answer the question asked, give the context, the action and the result, then check it landed.
